note: Main application sidebar -- renders: user status, fixed navigation icons (Home, Messages, etc.), and platform-defined section labels
Channel/room list sidebar -- renders: platform-defined section headers and navigation items for the user's subscribed channels
Sidebar footer -- renders: platform logo and version information
Sidebar user profile block -- renders: current user's display name and status
Main content page heading -- renders: fixed section title (e.g., 'Channels')
Tab navigation -- renders: fixed view switcher labels (e.g., 'All', 'Starred', 'Archived')
Search input container -- renders: search box for filtering channels
Table header row -- renders: fixed column headers (e.g., 'Name', 'Members', 'Last Activity')
Pagination controls -- renders: page numbers and navigation buttons
